author: Mark Atwood
text:
Propagated canonical MemoryError shape to the 3 remaining laggard sibling crates: chat-server, contacts-server, sharing-server.

## Pre-state survey

The workspace was partway through this migration already:

- jmap-mail-server (canonical), calendars-server, filenode-server, metadata-server, tasks-server: already on canonical `#[non_exhaustive] struct MemoryError { description: String }` shape with `MemoryError::new()` + `MemoryError::description()` (per bd:JMAP-ic0j.1; reshape in commit 2941c50; propagated to filenode in commit e9b66a3, etc.).
- chat-server, contacts-server, sharing-server: still on the tuple shape `pub struct MemoryError(pub String)`.

This bead .35 was filed against chat-server but the engineering basis applies workspace-wide — and most of the workspace had already converged on the canonical shape. The three laggards just had to catch up.

## Shape applied (mirrors mail-server canonical)

  #[non_exhaustive]
  #[derive(Debug)]
  pub struct MemoryError {
      description: String,
  }

  impl MemoryError {
      pub fn new(description: impl Into<String>) -> Self { ... }
      pub fn description(&self) -> &str { ... }
  }

  impl std::fmt::Display for MemoryError {
      fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
          write!(f, "MemoryBackend error: {}", self.description)
      }
  }

  impl std::error::Error for MemoryError {}

## Call-site migration

All tuple-construction sites updated:

- chat-server/src/memory.rs: 5 sites
- chat-server/tests/common/mod.rs: 11 sites (FaultyBackend wrapper)
- contacts-server/src/memory.rs: 7 sites
- sharing-server/src/memory.rs: 5 sites

Zero external `.0` field reads found in any of the three crates' src or tests trees (the type's tuple field was effectively write-only outside the type itself; the Display impl was the only public way to extract the string). Migration is therefore zero-friction at the call-site layer.

## Display-impl wire-format note

Display now prepends 'MemoryBackend error: ' to the description, matching mail-server canonical. Previously chat/contacts/sharing wrote just the description. Effect on consumers: error messages logged via Display now have a 'MemoryBackend error:' prefix. This is a deliberate normalization toward the canonical wire-format; it lands the three laggards on the same diagnostic shape as the other five sibling crates. No tests asserted the previous prefix-less Display output (grep verified).

## Gates

- cargo check --workspace --all-features: clean
- cargo clippy --all-features (3 modified crates): clean
- cargo test --all-features (3 modified crates): all 460+ tests pass
- cargo doc --no-deps --all-features (3 modified crates): chat-server clean, contacts-server clean. sharing-server has a pre-existing rustdoc error in principal.rs unrelated to this change.
- cargo fmt --all: clean

Diff: +142 lines / -49 lines across 4 files (1 src file + 1 test file in chat-server; 1 src file each in contacts and sharing).

## Closes

Closes JMAP-x2gd.35. The workspace-canonical-template propagation is now complete for MemoryError.
